title: Front Cover Art
prompt:
Full-color premium children's fantasy book cover illustration in a polished painterly animated-feature style, Pixar-quality cinematic lighting. Scene: two humans and a companion in simple medieval fantasy adventure clothing, standing in a forest clearing discovering a swirling magical portal. A large friendly dragon rises protectively behind them, its wings subtly framing the composition. A distant castle silhouette is visible beyond the trees. The forest environment is rendered in cool twilight blues, indigo, and soft violet with subtle cool moonlight or sky fill from above and behind. The portal emits a warm golden magical key light with soft falloff, illuminating the characters' faces and nearby ground with localized warm light, creating strong warm–cool contrast against the cool forest atmosphere. Shadows lean blue-violet and teal, no brown or orange. Soft volumetric glow surrounds the portal, with light mist or particles catching cool blue light in the distance. The dragon and characters have expressive faces, rendered with smooth gradients and volumetric glow, no heavy black outlines, edges defined by light and color transitions. Composition fills the lower 65–70% of the cover with subjects; the upper 30–35% is a clean, uncluttered cool-toned sky area reserved for the title. Title text: "The Dragon Realm Adventure" in elegant fantasy serif typography, gold-ivory lettering with subtle bevel and soft warm glow, centered horizontally in the upper sky area with generous margin above and breathing room from the top edge. No clutter behind the title, no extra text or symbols anywhere. The overall lighting is cinematic global illumination with soft rim lighting separating characters from background, maintaining full color depth and dynamic lighting. No line art, no coloring-book style, no placeholder boxes or fake lettering. The final image is a high-end animated fantasy film frame, rich saturation, painterly lighting, and premium quality suitable for a children's storybook cover.
